messages.content: Write a short announcement for a new feature in a note-taking app: offline sync. Around 200 words.

**Offline sync is here**

You can now write in [App] without a connection. Open a note on a plane, in a basement, on a train through a tunnel, and it saves to your device immediately. When you're back online, everything you wrote syncs to your other devices in the background.

The tricky part was edits from two places at once. If you added a paragraph on your laptop while your phone was offline and you also edited that same note on your phone, we merge both sets of changes instead of picking a winner. Where a real conflict exists (the same line changed two different ways), we keep both versions and mark the spot so you can decide.

A few details worth knowing:

Your notes are stored encrypted on the device, same as they are on our servers. Attachments over 25 MB wait for Wi-Fi by default; you can change that in Settings under Sync. The sync indicator in the sidebar shows what's pending, and you can tap it to see which notes haven't uploaded yet.

Offline sync is on for everyone starting today, no setup required. If you hit a merge that looks wrong, send it to us through Help → Report a sync issue and we'll look at the history.

output:
**Offline sync is here**

Connection or not, [App] keeps working. Write a note on a plane, in a basement, or on a train inside a tunnel, and it saves to your device right then. Once you have signal, that note finds your other devices on its own, without you doing anything.

The hard part was edits from two places at once. Say you add a paragraph on your laptop while your phone is offline, and you edit the same note on the phone. We combine both sets of changes rather than choosing one. If the same line was changed two different ways, we keep both versions and mark the spot for you to settle.

Some details worth knowing. Notes sit encrypted on your device, the way they already do on our servers. Attachments above 25 MB wait for Wi-Fi unless you change that in Settings, under Sync. The sync indicator in the sidebar shows what is still pending; tap it for a list of notes that have not uploaded.

Everyone has offline sync as of today, and there is nothing to switch on. If a merge looks wrong to you, send it over through Help → Report a sync issue and we will go through the history.
